requests.assessment: Returned official division selector; Dhaka division code 010000000.
Listed Munshiganj district under comcod 4105 (unitcod 011400000) and a distinct Diara survey listing (comcod 4198).
Only Gazaria upazila exposed; selected entry is Char Kalipur mouza unitcod 011402071, sheet 001. This identifies an official candidate sheet, but not the queued urban-centre name.

Bounded check of sanitized geometry and Dag_No found 0 polygons intersecting a 400m-square test around the WUP coordinate. No owner attributes retained. Thus the available Char Kalipur sheet does not verify Narayanpur target coverage.

coverageAssessment.finding: The exact Narayanpur place-name / WUP coordinate match is unresolved. The official Munshiganj selector exposed a BDS sheet for Char Kalipur mouza (unitcod 011402071, sheet 001); it returned 97 polygons with Dag_No IDs, but none intersected the 400m-square test around the WUP point. This confirms an operational DLRS geometry+ID source for a nearby mouza only; it does not establish Narayanpur target coverage or target-specific registry existence.

nextStep: Resolve the exact Narayanpur place-name to a mouza around the WUP point; enumerate adjacent Gazaria BDS sheets and sample only the correct target-intersecting sheet, then confirm stable Dag_No identity in that sheet.
